name: Product Line Classification, SLA, Reporting
foundation_dependencies: LLD-02 Customer Organization identity and Customer Account Code matching evidence
LLD-03 Service Request identity/lifecycle/current Customer context and accepted source projection readers
LLD-04 accepted source-observation provenance for Report Date/status/severity/suspension evidence
scope: Contract Product Line identity and lifecycle
immutable SLA policy revisions and exact cohort tiers
IT/NFV default policy templates and derived Non-fault inquiry tiers
deterministic reviewed SR classification and mapping rules
live cohort state and exact percentage arithmetic
immutable completed report evidence after verified XLSX artifact generation
report staging/failure cleanup and minimum historical snapshot evidence
not_owned_here: Service Request source facts/lifecycle/Customer authority -> LLD-03/LLD-04
authentication/action proof and release dependency pinning -> LLD-12
design_principle: Reusable Product Line identity never carries global SLA authority. Current SLA truth is a reproducible projection over the SR's resolved Customer-compatible Contract Product Line, its current immutable policy revision and accepted source chronology; completed report evidence freezes only the minimum represented state after artifact verification and never becomes operational cleanup authority.
